_comment: CONTROL variant. Cosmetically rewritten, behaviourally identical. Exists to falsify our reading of the semantic result, not to score models.

mutation.description: COSMETIC ONLY, COST-NEUTRAL: renamed variables and an extracted helper. Shifts are preserved exactly (`<< 7`, `>> 3`) and no arithmetic is substituted. No behavioural change and, by construction, no change in gas.
mutation._retracted: This field previously described `* 128` for `<< 7` and `/ 8` for `>> 3`. That WAS the first control, and it was confounded: mul/div cost more than the shifts, so the control had 2.8x the headroom of the semantic task and the comparison was invalid (Addendum 8, retracted). ControlTask.sol was rewritten cost-neutral; this description was not, and the stale text was copied verbatim into the machine-readable batch records. A name binds nothing -- the lesson the scenario digest already encodes, not yet applied to the task.
